title: Pack manifest
description: An installable vertical application. Bundles agents, tools, guardrails, memory schemas, capability declarations, and UI metadata — all as data. Installation is 'load this manifest into tenant config'. Pack tools reach the runtime over MCP (`mcpEndpoint`), as a handler artifact (`codeArtifactRef`), or as a declarative `spec`; pack code runs outside the runtime server process, in a separate process or container.

manifestVersion.description: Version of the pack manifest schema itself. Bumped on breaking manifest changes.

id.description: Globally unique pack id (dotted lowercase, e.g. 'com.acme.support').

requiresOsVersion.description: Semver range of Kindgi runtime versions this pack is compatible with (e.g. '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0').

agents.description: Agents this pack contributes. Each is a full agent definition (declarative).

flows.description: Task flows this pack contributes (references to flow documents).

tools.description: Tools this pack contributes. Tools that run pack code point at it through an `mcpEndpoint` (the pack's MCP server) or a `codeArtifactRef` (a handler artifact); declarative tools carry a `spec`.

memorySchemas.description: Fact type schemas this pack defines. Registered so the memory layer knows how to validate writes.

capabilities.description: Capability declarations named by this pack (referenced by pack agents).

ui.description: Optional metadata for how Kindgi UIs display this pack (icon, category, tags, external app URL).

requiredNeeds.description: Context slots this pack requires the tenant to have configured (e.g. 'model:vision-capable', 'blob', 'compliance-provider'). Install fails if any is unmet.

permissions.description: Permissions this pack asks the admin to grant on install (e.g. 'memory:write:facts', 'blob:write', 'events:emit'). Enforced by the tenant policy engine.

instructions.description: System prompt / instructions for the agent.

capabilities.description: Reference to a capability declaration by id, or an inline capability declaration.

tools.description: Tools this agent is allowed to call, as `{ id, version }` references — the same `ToolRef` shape as `agent.schema.json`. Schema-version 1.1.0 replaced the bare-string tool ids of 1.0.0.

memory.description: Memory binding configuration (which fact types the agent reads/writes, retrieval hints).

guardrails.description: Guardrail ids that apply to this agent.

path.description: Relative path (within the pack bundle) to a JSON file conforming to flow.schema.json.
Relative path to a JSON file conforming to tool.schema.json.

factType.description: Fact type identifier this schema governs.

schema.description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for the fact content.

retrieve.description: Default retrieval hint for facts of this type.

externalAppUrl.description: URL of the pack's own user-facing UI (separate app consuming the Kindgi client SDK). A pack's own drafting UI, for example, lives here — not embedded in Kindgi's own UI.
